name: Certificate Chain Fetcher
description: Fetch the certificate chain a host actually sends, with a chain summary and verification result.

hints.private: Private, loopback and link-local addresses are always blocked.

faq.q: Is this the chain the server really sends?
faq.a: Yes. Only certificates presented during the TLS handshake are returned; nothing is added.

faq.q: What if the chain is incomplete?
faq.a: Use the chain repair tool to append the missing intermediates.
No. Responses are discarded immediately and never written to storage or logs.
